title: A domain a Space bought in Frequency renews on time, charged to the Space, and a stuck order is reconciled

source.ref: LIVE-781 follow-up: the renewal charge loop and the order reconcile over space_domain_purchases (owner ruling 2026-10-06: the Space pays renewals)

detail: A registered domain is renewed only after its Space payment succeeds. The existing monitored billing-renewals handler runs billing first, then a bounded domain sweep within the shared 200-item/time budget; payment failure, unresolved order, attention state or deferred work returns a failing heartbeat. Vercel auto-renew is disabled before any new charge, and registry expiration is checked against the stored renewal period. Conditional period-bound database claims and persisted payment/order IDs prevent duplicate submissions. Ambiguous payments or provider submissions require operator review; no blind retry. Ordered purchases are reconciled to registered or refunded after provider refund history confirms no prior successful refund. Purchasing rows older than an hour surface for operator review. The domain purchase switch prevents new charges while reconciliation of already paid orders continues. Migration 066 is additive and preserves existing RLS/client restrictions; PGlite verifies replay, constraints and conditional claims. 121 focused tests pass, covering recovery, expiration drift, refund history, shared budget and heartbeat failure propagation. No additional schedule or monitor is created.

verify.note: Plain Node checks bounded sweep, payment/provider claims, refund history and failure propagation through the existing monitored handler; no test runner or live provider calls.
